description: Make a level the building's ground floor: the one standing at grade, its floor on the ground. A building's levels stack on a ground line; the levels with a lower floor index are below grade (basements), the ones at or over it are not, and list_levels reads it as groundLevels (levelId, floorElevation, floorOverGrade, seated) and each level's gradeStanding (at-grade, partly-below-grade, below-grade) and isGroundLevel. This names the level on the building, seats the building so that level's floor datum stands on grade (flat site: world Y 0; sculpted terrain: the mean ground height under its floor), moving the building in height only — the plan stays where it is and every level keeps its place relative to the others — and renumbers the floor indices so it is 0 and the ones under it are -1, -2…. A level added below (add_level position below) stacks under the lowest level without moving the ground floor. A roof level or a support level cannot be the ground floor (not_a_storey). One undo step. Refusals: level_not_found, not_a_level, no_building, not_a_storey. Answering unchanged: true when the level is already the named ground floor, on grade, at index 0.

levelId.description: The level to stand at grade, by an id list_levels returned.
